title: dev-next audit: token counts are blank when sub-agents run as agent-team teammates
summary: dev-next's audit now fills a sub-agent's token figure from its transcript when the Agent tool reports none (as with agent-team teammates), through a stdlib helper script that always exits 0 and records null with a reason when it cannot find one.

deferred.what: The name lookup searches every project on the computer, so another session's agent with the same name since the run started can be recorded as this agent's figure: a wrong number where the rule says never guess.
deferred.why: Restricting the search to the lead session's project folder needs Claude Code's project-folder naming.

deferred.what: Where a teammate's transcript lives is still unproven against a real agent-team run; a teammate in its own terminal pane likely gets no figure.
deferred.why: No team-mode run has happened on this computer; the first one should confirm or extend the lookup.

deferred.what: The One file row, the Stack line and the scripts/ list do not name skills/dev-next/scripts/agent_tokens.py, so a later agent does not know it exists or how to check it.
deferred.why: CLAUDE.md changes only on the person's word.

deferred.what: With agent teams on, every spawn that passes a name launches as a teammate; dropping name in that mode would keep sub-agents as sub-agents so the tool reports their figures.
The Agent tool's figure is close to the size of a sub-agent's last request (cache reads included), not the whole run's cost, so audit numbers mislead anyone reading them as cost.
deferred.why: The issue keeps records without team mode unchanged.
